title.narrative: UN Secondment to coordinate Nepal Risk Reduction Consortium

description.narrative: This activity UN Secondment to coordinate Nepal Risk Reduction Consortium is a component of UK Support to Increase Resilience to Natural Disasters in Nepal reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £1,321,736. It works in the following sector(s): Disaster prevention and preparedness, Environmental policy and administrative management, Material relief assistance and services.
